findings.title: Enable secret not found
findings.evidence: No 'enable secret' command was found in global configuration.
findings.recommendation: Configure a strong enable secret using the approved credential policy.

findings.title: Legacy enable password command present
findings.recommendation: Prefer 'enable secret'; review and remove legacy credentials safely.

findings.title: Password obfuscation service not enabled
findings.evidence: The 'service password-encryption' command was not found.
findings.recommendation: Review credential handling. This command provides weak obfuscation, not strong encryption; use stronger supported secret mechanisms.

findings.title: No local username using secret syntax detected
findings.evidence: No matching local username/secret line was found.
findings.recommendation: Verify the intended AAA design and configure protected local credentials if local authentication is required.

findings.title: SSH version 2 not explicitly configured
findings.evidence: The exact command 'ip ssh version 2' was not found.
findings.recommendation: If supported by the platform, explicitly configure SSH version 2.

findings.title: Telnet permitted on VTY lines
findings.evidence: line vty 0 4: transport input permits Telnet.
findings.recommendation: Where supported, restrict remote management to SSH and validate access before applying changes.

findings.title: VTY idle timeout not detected
findings.evidence: No exec-timeout command found in line vty 0 4.
findings.recommendation: Set an appropriate idle timeout according to your security policy.

findings.title: Access port assigned to VLAN 1
findings.evidence: GigabitEthernet0/0 is explicitly configured as an access port in VLAN 1.
findings.recommendation: Check the network design and move user access ports to an approved VLAN if appropriate.

findings.title: Access port security not detected
findings.evidence: GigabitEthernet0/0 is an access port without a port-security command.
findings.recommendation: Assess whether port security is supported and appropriate for this port.

findings.title: Trunk allowed-VLAN list not explicit
findings.evidence: GigabitEthernet0/1 is configured as a trunk without an explicit allowed-VLAN line.
findings.recommendation: Define only the VLANs required on this trunk, after verifying the topology.

limitations: Offline static analysis only; no device connection was made.
A missing command is not proof of a vulnerability.
Rules must be validated against the device model, IOS version and approved policy.
The score is a project heuristic, not a formal CVSS score.
